turns.prompt_text: which is healthier a joule an NJoy or a vuse
turns.response_html:
Health experts generally agree that none are "healthy," as all three deliver addictive nicotine and chemical aerosols that can damage your lungs and heart. However, if you are comparing them based on ingredients and nicotine delivery:

  • Vuse and JUUL typically use nicotine salts, which allow for very high nicotine concentrations that can increase addiction potential more rapidly than older devices.
  • NJoy often contains slightly fewer flavor chemicals in its core lineup compared to some competitors, but it still carries significant cardiovascular risks.
  • Vuse has the most "PMTA" (PreMarket Tobacco Product Application) authorizations from the FDA, meaning their data was scrutinized more heavily for public health standards, though this doesn't make them "safe."

The healthiest choice is avoiding all three. If you're trying to quit, would you like me to find some FDA-approved cessation resources or apps?
